citations.assessment: The two forms introduce the question on divine truth and kindness.
The earlier Ilfa dossier is the target of the conjectural pointer.
The primary account has the name alternatives and the two liturgical lines. Ilfa says he brings wine and fulfills the villagers’ obligation on their behalf. Heilprin reports that he gave them wine.
